record.reason: The work evaluates LLM reasoning as a multiobjective scheduler for HPC workloads and explicitly notes computational overhead that challenges real-time use. This concerns using an LLM to schedule HPC jobs, not scheduling LLM inference workloads, so the systems connection remains indirect.
record.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of LLM-Based Reasoning for Multiobjective HPC Job Scheduling
